failed_cases.reason: A manifest-to-contract identity/hash substitution was classified as a generic manifest mismatch instead of the frozen contract-boundary denial.
The gateway evaluated current manifest/base cross-binding before consulting the already durable idempotency binding, masking semantic rebinding as a generic manifest mismatch.

adjudication: This is a gateway code defect in deterministic validation ordering/classification. The frozen S3 fixture and expectations remain valid and unchanged. The narrow repair authority is limited to making contract-substitution classification explicit and ensuring an existing durable idempotency binding is consulted before mutable cross-binding checks can mask rebinding.
